dedupe_keys.name: cyber incidents in european healthcare settings with potential health impacts may 2022 to april 2023 jrc

description: This dataset lists cyber incidents in European healthcare settings that could affect patients' health, found in news media between 1 May 2022 and 30 April 2023. It was compiled by Vittorio Reina of the European Commission's Joint Research Centre using the Europe Media Monitor news aggregation tool, and it also gives the keywords used to configure the monitor. The aim was to see how much information exists on incidents with significant potential health impacts, such as delayed treatment, and whether reports described actual consequences for patients, such as deaths or deterioration of health; the accompanying JRC report by Reina and Griesinger (2024) found that such evidence is scarce and often contradictory. Searches covered media in English, German, Italian, French and Spanish. The spreadsheet is free to download online; reuse is authorised under the European Commission reuse notice with acknowledgement of the source. Caveats: the authors note that other European languages were not covered, so results may not represent the whole Union, and media reports are incomplete. Simulation uses: incident frequencies and impact types for cyber disruption scenarios in hospital service models. Related records: the Swiss BACS cyber incident statistics (data-bacs-cyber-incident-statistics-switzerland) are a national reporting series.
